description:
Add a built-in codex runner type. Extend RunnerConfigSchema with: type: 'codex', optional model override, optional API key env var name (default: OPENAI_API_KEY). Implement CodexRunner in src/runner/codex.ts implementing AgentRunner.

Invoke as:

  codex "<rendered prompt>"

with OTTO_REPO_PATH as cwd and the API key env var in the environment. Capture stdout directly as plain text — Codex CLI does not support a structured output mode, so supportsStructuredOutput is always false for this runner. Summary = stdout truncated to 500 chars.

Share the prompt rendering logic with T-043 via src/runner/prompt.ts (same context-to-prompt function, same sourceType framing, same lineContext rendering, same git instructions). Omit the structured output / comment ID sections of the prompt since Codex doesn't support that path.

The prompt must cover the same points as T-043 items 1–7 (framing, repo context, reviews, comment thread, line contexts, git instructions), minus item 6 (comment IDs for structured output) and item 8 (plain-text summary instruction, which can be included but Codex output is used as-is regardless).

Config env var for the API key should be configurable (default: OPENAI_API_KEY). Update config schema, loader, and runner factory so type: 'codex' instantiates CodexRunner.
title: Built-in Codex runner
